- **Big Brand Tire & Service**, **3687 Old Santa Rita Rd** — listed at about **4.7 stars across 714 reviews**. Note that it shares the same street address as Seever & Son’s, so confirm which business you’re booking with.
- **America’s Tire**, **6450 Dublin Blvd, Dublin** — just outside Pleasanton; Tire Rack lists it as a top-rated installer based on customer surveys.

**Bottom line:** I’d call Seever & Son’s first for a local shop and ask for an out-the-door quote. Ratings and availability can change, so it’s worth checking directly before you go.
